# Hash-pinned build backend and its dependencies for the release build
# (uv build --build-constraints .github/build-constraints.txt --require-hashes).
# Keep the setuptools version equal to [build-system] requires in pyproject.toml.
# Regenerate after changing it, and before each release. --exclude-newer keeps
# every pin at least seven days old, the same cooldown as dependabot.yml:
#   echo "setuptools==<version>" | uv pip compile - --universal \
#     --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 --exclude-newer <date 7 days ago> \
#     --no-header --no-annotate -o .github/build-constraints.txt
# Generated with --exclude-newer 2026-10-15.
